title: egg cooker pan
text: egg cooker pan. Ok... this pan isn't necessary, but it's nice when you want to make perfect looking eggs - nice and round. Works great for putting on top of a muffin or biscuit.  A couple of notes... I have a glass top and the pan works just great.  I put a little bit of butter or olive oil in each cup for better release of the egg.  I also use a lid to finish cooking.  I did purchase the narrow spatula - a good buy.  It does work much easier than a wider one. The other thing that I think is something to note - I only use the pan when I will be making 4 eggs.  I don't want to heat the other cups when they are empty.  It is what I would say is a light/medium weight.  It's washed up nicely - I only hand wash this type of coated cooking pan.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review has been helpful to you!
